question: In which battle did the English East India Company fleet under Captain Thomas Best defeat the Portuguese in 1612 near Surat, demonstrating their naval capability to the Mughal Emperor Jahangir?
explanation: The Battle of Swally took place on November 29-30, 1612, off the coast of Suvali (Surat). The English success impressed Jahangir, leading to the establishment of the first English factory at Surat.

question: Which island was acquired by King Charles II of England as part of his dowry from the Portuguese Princess Catherine of Braganza in 1661, and later leased to the East India Company, becoming their chief naval headquarters in western India?
explanation: Bombay was transferred to England in 1661 as part of Catherine of Braganza's dowry. In 1668, King Charles II leased it to the English East India Company for an annual rent of 10 pounds, leading to the shift of EIC headquarters from Surat to Bombay.
